Derive both from the spec's widget-type vocabulary, filtered by the types the console's renderer registry actually renders.
- Block palette: `metadata-admin/previews/block-types.ts` keeps documented exclusions with reasons (≈L218–268: `record:chatter` is a compatibility alias of `record:discussion` and is left out of the palette on purpose). The card's "lacks 8 of 34" counts those. Measure each of the 8. A block excluded with a recorded reason stays excluded; say so per block in the report. Only blocks missing with no reason are added.
- The dataset help text (`engine.inspector.widget.datasetHint`, studio namespace `en.ts` ≈L503) mentions "the inline object query above", which does not exist. Reword it in en and zh to describe the real controls.
- Each widget type needs a label key. Add the missing `engine.inspector.widget.type.*` rows in the studio namespace en/zh.

These metadata-admin files are shared with the Setup pages, so the change must be the same in both. Tests: the Add menu and the Type picker offer the same set, equal to the renderable spec types; each newly offered block is placeable; a test pins that the two pickers read one source. Ablation: put one hand-kept list back; the parity test turns red. ⛔ No change to renderers or to the spec vocabulary.
